II: Stouppe to the prince of Tarente, Aug 1654, p. 498 (says 'I do send you a cypher'); prince of Tarente to Stouppe, Hague 21 Aug 1654 N.S., p. 537 (received the cypher with Stouppe's letter of the 14th); Stouppe to Tarente, London 25 Aug 1654, pp. 565-566, with figure groups left in the French text ('Quelques uns croyent qu'il y pourroit 15. 73. 10. 24 ...'), i.e. cipher numbers printed but unresolved. Birch cites the source as Thurloe vol. xvii (= Rawl. A. 17) p. 62. Rawl. A.17 p.63 corresponds to the Tarente letter (p.537). The other Rawlinson pages (A.18 pp.159, 282, 422; A.19 pp.81, 361, 497; A.20 p.31), covering Oct-Nov 1654, do not appear in Birch (only three Stouppe/Tarente letters in vol. II). The 25 Aug letter with unresolved figure strings would make a crib set if the Rawlinson copy supplies the key. Not closed.
